author: Good Enough
description:
Medieval surgeons believed draining swellings and infections could cure disease. During the Middle Ages, barber-surgeons would open swollen areas to release pus and fluid, hoping it would remove the illness and help patients recover. This Short explores one of the most common—and often painful, medical treatments used before the development of modern medicine.

Discover the surprising methods medieval surgeons relied on and why these procedures remained common for centuries.
title: Medieval Surgeons Drained Everything 🩸😧 #didyouknow #history #facts #medieval #shorts
